other_conditions: For Stream SA: must have passed 10th class with at least 75% marks (65% for SC/ST/PwD) and be enrolled in 12th science stream.
For Stream SX: must have passed 12th class with at least 75% marks (65% for SC/ST/PwD) and be enrolled in higher education with a science subject.
For Stream SB: must have passed 12th class with at least 75% marks (65% for SC/ST/PwD) and be enrolled in the first year of graduation with a science subject
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarships of ₹5,000 for school students and ₹7,000 for undergraduate/post‑graduate students, together with annual contingency grants and research opportunities.
